Michele Pelafas
Thu, Apr 30, 2:15 PM (4 days ago)
to Eric, me

Hi Eric,

 

It was great meeting you, and I’m glad we had the chance to connect. Bethany, I really enjoyed our initial conversation as well—I appreciate the level of thought you’ve both put into building Luxora.

 

Great question on ROI. While I haven’t conducted a formal ROI study across projects, we consistently see that the physical environment has a meaningful impact on performance—everything from pricing power and client perception to retail, conversion, and retention. Because each project is highly customized, the results tend to be specific to the business rather than something we’ve historically packaged into a standardized metric.

 

I also wanted to share a bit of context on how I’ve built my business, as I think it’s important in shaping how we approach working together.

 

Over the past 22+ years, I’ve been very intentional about keeping my brand clean, focused, and centered in design. I haven’t built my business around promoting partners through websites or in marketing materials, as staying neutral has allowed me to maintain a high level of trust with clients and strong relationships across the industry.

 

That said, I do have a network of specialists I refer clients to when it’s the right fit. I see a real opportunity for us to recommend each other in a way that feels aligned with the client and the stage of their business.

 

For me, the right next step would be to approach this as you outlined in Phase One—keeping it simple and results-driven. A handful of thoughtful introductions in each direction would give us a clear sense of fit, client alignment, and overall synergy before expanding anything further.

 

Looking forward to continuing the conversation~!

Subject: Excited to Move Forward Together

Hi Michele,

It was so great connecting with you, and I really appreciate the thoughtful response you shared. You’ve built something incredibly strong and intentional, and that absolutely comes through in how you approach both your work and your relationships.

I want to start by saying we would love to move forward with those first steps exactly as you outlined. Keeping this simple, aligned, and results-driven in Phase One makes complete sense, and we are fully on board with that approach.

From our side, I also want to be very clear on how we see this long term. You would 100% be our go-to designer for med spa clients. The level of sophistication, brand integrity, and experience you bring is exactly what our clients need as they grow and elevate their spaces.

That said, we also want to be respectful of what you’ve already built. We are not looking to convolute your process or take over your methods in any way. If anything, we see this as enhancing what already works. Our goal is to support through natural, organic collaboration and referrals, not force anything that doesn’t feel aligned.

There may be a few custom elements we layer in on our side as we integrate with clients’ broader growth strategies, but always in a way that complements your work, not competes with or complicates it.

Separately, as we continue to grow, we are in a position to feature a trusted design partner within our ecosystem and client-facing materials. If that’s something you’d still be open to exploring in a way that feels aligned with your brand and boundaries, I’d love to talk through what that could look like together.

If you’re open to it, let’s get a follow-up call on the calendar to map out Phase One introductions and make sure we’re set up for success on both sides.

Really excited about where this could go.

Best,  
Bethany
